parts:

I worked out few month ago, I can see my results. but now, I update my R packages, I can not see any results of my model.

I tried to re-fit again, but also I can not see any results with error messages.

Can you check it out?

Seongho

messages.subject: Re: I can not see any results with errors.
parts:
Seongho,

I'm pretty sure this is an instantiation of the coef() bug mentioned a post or two below. This should be fixed in the development version of lavaan (this was on the lavaan, not blavaan, side), or it should work if you do this:

summary(as(MLM_BSEM, "lavaan"), fit.measures=TRUE, standardize=TRUE, rsquare=TRUE)


Ed
